event_name: Date 16 September 2018 Time 22:12 2018 SINGAPORE GRAND PRIX 13 - 16 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Incident between cars 11 and 35 in turn 18.
offence: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Drive through penalty (3 penalty points awarded, 5 points for the 12 month period)
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that whilst overtaking car 35 after T 17, car 11 moved to the left on a straight and collided with car 35, which was deemed potentially dangerous.
rules_referenced: Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
